                 FAQ 

                 
                     
                         1. Why Submit Your AI Tool with Us? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                         We are dedicated to becoming the premier AI tool directory. By promoting your website tool with us, you can gain direct website traffic and user clicks. 
                         Reach over 200,000 monthly visitors. 
                         Receive a valuable dofollow backlink. 
                         Benefit from a multi-language introduction. 
                     
                     
                         2. What Types of Tools and Services Are Accepted? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Before submitting your tool, please perform a site search to ensure it's not already listed. We manually review each tool before publication. Our platform exclusively features AI tools, not newsletters or directories. Therefore, kindly refrain from submitting newsletter or directory links. Please be aware that all submissions undergo an approval process. While we may sometimes be lenient in approvals, we retain the right to reject or remove products even after approval.
                     
                     
                         3. When Will My Tool Be Listed? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Due to high demand, our submission queue currently takes 30-60 days. However, you have the option to expedite the process for just $9.9.
                     
                     
                         4. How Can I Edit My Listing? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        You can request edits to your listing by emailing us at support@aitoolnet.com. Please use the subject line "Update Tool Listing - [Your Tool Name]."
                     
                     
                         5. How Can I Get Featured or Promote My Tool? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        To get started with featuring or promoting your tool, use the boosted submission option or reach out to us for additional packages and options.
                     
                 

                 
                     
                         1. How Much Does It Cost to List a Tool? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Listing a tool costs $9.9, which is a one-time payment. Once paid, your tool will be listed indefinitely.
                     
                     
                         2. How Long Does It Take to Get Listed After Payment and Submission? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                         For real-time tracking of your tool's listing status, we recommend using the homepage's advanced search feature. It offers superior filtering and algorithms compared to the basic search. 
                         Upon successful submission and payment, we will list your tool within 24 hours. You can check the following day to see your tool live on the site. 
                     
                     
                         3. How Can I Edit My Listing? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        To edit your listing, simply email us at support@aitoolnet.com with your requested changes. Please use the subject line "Update Tool Listing – [Your Tool Name]."
                     
                     
                         4. Why Wasn't My Tool Listed? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Before submitting your tool, please perform a site search to ensure it's not already listed. We manually review each tool before publication. Our platform exclusively features AI tools, not newsletters or directories. Therefore, kindly refrain from submitting newsletter or directory links. If your tool isn't approved for any reason, you will receive a full refund of your listing fee. Common reasons for non-approval include the tool not utilizing AI or being already listed.
                     
                     
                         5. Can You Guarantee Sales or Traffic? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                         We cannot guarantee that listing your AI tool on Aitoolnet will result in sales or traffic. However, based on our traffic statistics, it is likely that your tool/website will receive some clicks. As our website continues to grow, your exposure also increases. 
                         Several factors can enhance your chances of receiving visits, such as having a unique tool name, a clear use case, and well-chosen keywords. When listing your tool, we consider all these aspects to provide you with the best possible exposure. 
                     
                 

                 
                     
                         1. How Much Does a Featured Listing Cost? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Our featured listings are currently priced at $49.9 and are active for a duration of 7 days.
                     
                     
                         2. When Will My Featured Listing Go Live? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        Typically, we review featured listings within 24 hours of payment. After the review, you should receive an email notifying you of your scheduled featured listing date.
                     
                     
                         3. Can I Renew My Featured Listing? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        If you're satisfied with the results and wish to extend your featured listing, you can choose to renew it at any time. Simply send an email to support@aitoolnet.com and complete the payment form again to extend your featured listing for an additional 7 days. If you're interested in a longer placement, feel free to contact us via email.
                     
                     
                         4. What Types of Tools and Services Are Accepted for Featured Listings? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        We conduct a manual review of every tool submitted for a featured listing. If your tool is not approved for any reason, you will receive a full refund of your featured listing fee. Common reasons for non-approval include the tool not utilizing AI or having malicious intent. Please ensure you include your tool's URL when making the payment for a featured listing.
                     
                     
                         5. Can You Guarantee Sales or Traffic? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                         We cannot guarantee that listing your AI tool on Aitoolnet will result in sales or traffic. However, based on our traffic statistics, it is likely that your tool/website will receive some clicks. As our website continues to grow, your exposure also increases. 
                         Several factors can increase your chances of receiving visits, such as having a unique tool name, a clear use case, and well-chosen keywords. When listing your tool, we take all these aspects into account and strive to provide you with the best possible exposure. 
                     
                     
                         6. What Is the Refund Policy? 
                         + 
                     
                     
                        We offer a full, automatic refund in cases where your AI tool doesn't get published due to our editorial policy. We also provide refunds for Featured/sponsorships if they haven't started yet. Your satisfaction is important to us, and we aim to ensure a fair and transparent refund process.
                     
                 
             
         
     
 
 
    let nowtime = new Date().valueOf()
    let num = Math.floor(Math.random() * (10000 - 1) + 1)
    let payid = 'id_' + nowtime + num
    document.getElementById('dr_payid').value = payid

    let title = '';
    let price = '';
    let payway = '1';
    let baseurl = 'https://www.aitoolnet.com/payment.php';
    // default
    title = 'Submit a tool pay $9.9';
    price = 9.9;
    submitfinishurl = '';
    submiturl = baseurl + '?payway=' + payway + '&x-payid=' + payid + '&x-money=' + price;
    document.querySelector('#btnSubmit').innerHTML="Submit Pay $9.9";
    const paytypeHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.paytype');
    paytypeHtml.forEach(function(option,index){
        option.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const itemAll = document.querySelectorAll('.paytype>div>p>span');
            itemAll.forEach(function(item){
                item.classList.add('bg-gray-400');
                item.classList.remove('bg-blue-500');
            });
            const itemList = option.querySelectorAll('div>p>span');
            itemList.forEach(function(item){
                item.classList.remove('bg-gray-400');
                item.classList.add('bg-blue-500');
            });

            const itemBoderAll = document.querySelectorAll('.paytype>div');
            itemBoderAll.forEach(function(item){
                item.classList.add('border-gray-300');
                item.classList.remove('border-blue-500');
            });
            const itemBoderList = option.querySelectorAll('div');
            itemBoderList.forEach(function(item){
                item.classList.remove('border-gray-300');
                item.classList.add('border-blue-500');
            });

            if (index==1){
                paytypeHtml[1].querySelector('div>span').classList.remove('bg-gray-300');
                paytypeHtml[1].querySelector('div>span').classList.add('bg-blue-500');
            }else {
                paytypeHtml[1].querySelector('div>span').classList.add('bg-gray-300');
                paytypeHtml[1].querySelector('div>span').classList.remove('bg-blue-500');
            }

            if (index==0){
                document.getElementById('dr_row_payway').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('dr_row_payway').classList.remove('is-horizontal');
            }else {
                document.getElementById('dr_row_payway').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('dr_row_payway').classList.add('is-horizontal');
            }

            if (index===0){
                title = 'Submit a tool';
                price = 0;
                document.querySelector('#btnSubmit').innerHTML="Submit Free";
            }else if(index===1){
                title = 'Submit a tool pay $9.9';
                price = 9.9;
                document.querySelector('#btnSubmit').innerHTML="Submit Pay $9.9";
            }else if(index===2){
                title = 'Submit a tool pay $49.9';
                price = 49.9;
                document.querySelector('#btnSubmit').innerHTML="Submit Pay $49.9";
            }else {
                title = 'Submit a tool pay $9.9';
                price = 9.9;
                document.querySelector('#btnSubmit').innerHTML="Submit Pay $9.9";
            }

            payway = document.getElementById('dr_payway').value;
            document.getElementById('dr_money').value = price.toString();
            if (index==0){
                submitfinishurl = 'https://www.aitoolnet.com/finish';
            }else {
                paramurl ='?payway=' + payway + '&x-payid=' + payid + '&x-money=' + price;
                submiturl = baseurl + paramurl;
                submitfinishurl = '';
            }

            const faqHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.faq');
            faqHtml.forEach(function(faqitem,faqindex){
                faqitem.classList.add('hidden');
                if(index == faqindex){
                    faqitem.classList.remove('hidden');
                }
            })

        });
    });

    const paywayHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.payway');
    paywayHtml.forEach(function(option,index){
        option.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (index==0){
                paywayHtml[0].classList.remove('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[0].classList.add('border-blue-500');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.add('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.remove('border-blue-500');
                document.getElementById('dr_payway').value = '1';
            }else if (index==1){
                paywayHtml[0].classList.add('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[0].classList.remove('border-blue-500');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.remove('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.add('border-blue-500');
                document.getElementById('dr_payway').value = '2';
            }else {
                paywayHtml[0].classList.remove('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[0].classList.add('border-blue-500');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.add('border-gray-300');
                paywayHtml[1].classList.remove('border-blue-500');
                document.getElementById('dr_payway').value = '1';
            }

            payway = document.getElementById('dr_payway').value;
            paramurl ='?payway=' + payway + '&x-payid=' + payid + '&x-money=' + price;
            submiturl = baseurl + paramurl;
        });
    });

    const questionHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question');
    questionHtml.forEach(function(option,index){
        option.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const answerHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-answer')[index];
            const iconHtml = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-icon')[index];
            if(answerHtml.classList.contains('hidden')){
                answerHtml.classList.remove('hidden');
                iconHtml.innerHTML = '-';
            }else {
                answerHtml.classList.add('hidden');
                iconHtml.innerHTML = '+';
            }
        });
    });

    function handleSubmit(){
        if(submitfinishurl){
            dr_ajax_submit('https://www.aitoolnet.com/index.php?s=form&c=website&m=post', 'myform', '2000', submitfinishurl)
        }else {
            email = document.getElementById('dr_email').value;
            submiturl = submiturl + '&email=' + email;
            dr_ajax_submit('https://www.aitoolnet.com/index.php?s=form&c=website&m=post', 'myform', '2000', submiturl)
        }
    }
